g.text: 38b · Public share link resolution, analytics and app handoff
Open shared link: GET /r/{token} (with User-Agent & Referrer)
Resolve share token via Content Service
Query share link token and fetch associated Reel record
Render "Reel unavailable or link expired" web page
Return active Reel and creator details
Increment share link visit count and record analytics event
Return Reel OpenGraph metadata and deep link URI
Redirect mobile device to velora://reel/{id} (or render web player)
